messages:
maya: heads-up — noticed a spike in fncall rejects on /invoke canary this morning. App teams reported user-facing failures (502) and console is bubbling a lot of structured_validation_fail errors. billing dashboard also shows token charges for those attempts. anyone seen this pattern before?
jun: can you paste a sample request + the validator payload? curious if this is a schema drift or a parse bug.
maya: pasted sample below:
```
POST /v1/invoke
{
  "input": "Summarize: ...",
  "tools": [{"name":"lookup", "args": {"id": 123}}]
}
--- validator log ---
ERROR structured_validation_fail: expected object for tool_return, got array
context: fncall.handler -> parseToolResponse
```
samir: ok that error makes sense — model produced an array for tool_return (edge-case in one model variant). two issue threads: 1) UX/observability: console needs a quick way to show which invocations are soft vs hard rejects, and 2) billing: are we charging when the model already emitted tokens then we reject? current pipeline bills when generation finishes, before validation.
olivia: console-team note: we can add a short row in the invocation timeline: "validation_outcome: hard_reject" with a hover that shows the validator message and sample output. also want ability to filter by outcome and by fallback route.
ops-bot: alert: canary-invoke-validation spike: 62 rejects in 5m, reject_rate 12% (baseline 0.7%). affected route: canary/strict-validator.
maya: routing question — can we auto-fallback rejected requests to a permissive-validator variant to avoid user-visible failures? downside: permissive might accept malformed tool response and downstream adapters could crash. also cost concerns if we double-run.
tomer: billing cliffnote: we bill on generation completion; even if validation later rejects, tokens were produced. options: a) move billable_event after validation (hard to change pipe), b) emit a credit/refund when validator marks a hard_reject, c) avoid producing tokens when strict-validation is required (i.e., pre-validate with cheaper model) — each has tradeoffs.
jun: pragmatic route: add telemetry flags now so we can reconcile and optionally credit. i.e., add validation_outcome, fallback_route, billable_flag to trace & billing event. then we can run a daily job to compute credits for hard_rejects. low-risk to start.
maya: proposed routing snippet (draft):
```yaml
routePolicy:
  - prefer: strict-validator
  - on_reject:
      action: route_to(permissive-validator)
      tag: validation_fallback
```
samir: i'll prototype attaching validation metadata to the trace span and billing event. fields: validation_outcome=[accepted,soft_reject,hard_reject], fallback_tag, route_id, validated_model_id, billable_after_validation=true/false. putting on traces will make console filters easy.
olivia: please also add a small UX copy for the console filter: "Show invocations that failed schema validation (hard_reject) — useful for debugging tool adapters." and a short tooltip: "Hard reject: model output failed structured-output checks; invocation aborted."
tomer: can we gate the change on canary -> 10% -> 50% -> full? i don't want credits/chargeback enabled on 100% until we confirm reconciler works. need an owner and a checklist: telemetry PR, billing PR, console filter, rollback plan.
maya: owner: samir (telemetry/billing proto) + olivia (console UI). i'll coordinate canary rollout.
samir: ack — i'll open a PR today for trace fields + billing flag. will add a small ingest-metric: validation_outcome_count.
olivia: ack, will mock UI and add to the rollout checklist.
ops-bot: note: created incident-4743211111 for tracking (assigned to maya).
maya: thanks — will post updates here. short term: samir/olivia to PR, then we run 10% canary with fallback off (observe), then enable fallback with metrics in slow ramp.
jun: one more ask — add example logs to the console that redact customer PII but include the failing part of tool_return so adapters can triage.
maya: good call. we'll include sample_output_snippet (redacted) in the trace metadata.
samir: thumbs up :) i'll sync with billing (tomer) on credit policy.
tomer: i'll draft the crediting rules and include ops-sre signoff.
olivia: putting UX mock into a draft PR and linking.
maya: great work team. :thumbsup:
